items.textEn: a) Nora haven't got long hair. / b) Nora hasn't got long hair.
a) We rarely watch TV in the evenings. / b) We rarely watches TV in the evenings.
a) "Is your father a young man?" "No, he's quite older." / b) "Is your father a young man?" "No, he's quite old."
a) It was 8 o'clock in the morning and Mrs O'Brian made pancakes. / b) It was 8 o'clock in the morning and Mrs O'Brian was making pancakes.
a) If it gets dark in here, I'll draw the curtains. / b) If it gets dark in here, I drew the curtains.
a) Have you ever twisted your ankle? / b) Did you ever twisted your ankle?
a) John hasn't eaten anything for breakfast time. / b) John hasn't eaten anything since breakfast time.
a) By the time I arrived home the children were fast asleep. / b) By the time I arrived home the children are fast asleep.
a) Where was these toys made? / b) Where were these toys made?

patterns.formula: When/If + EGA + HOZIRGI, EGA + HOZIRGI / will + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: When you put coins in this machine, it gives you a ticket. If you aren't careful, you will cut yourself.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mashinaga tanga solsangiz, chipta beradi. Ehtiyot bo'lmasangiz, o'zingizni kesib olasiz.

patterns.formula: too + SIFAT + for KIM + to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Mexican food is too spicy for me to eat.
patterns.exampleUz: Meksika taomi men uchun yeyishga juda achchiq.

patterns.formula: By the time + O'TGAN, EGA + were / had + V3
patterns.exampleEn: By the time I arrived home the children were fast asleep.
patterns.exampleUz: Men uyga kelgunimcha bolalar qattiq uxlab qolgan edi.
